name: 泊松分布图
description: 生成泊松样本并绘制 300 DPI 频率直方图、样本平滑 KDE 与理论泊松 PMF 对比图。
masterEvidence: 2026-08-16 用户自建第一个画图插件
泊松分布图升级为 2026 国赛论文级规范：300 DPI、PMF 主导、KDE 明确为参考

params.label: 泊松参数 λ
params.hint: 泊松分布参数 λ，即平均发生次数

params.label: 随机种子
params.hint: 固定种子保证结果可复现

code:
# 泊松分布图：2026 国赛论文级样本直方图 + KDE + 理论 PMF
import io
import base64
import numpy as np
import matplotlib
matplotlib.use('Agg')
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns
from scipy.stats import poisson
from matplotlib.ticker import MaxNLocator

plt.rcParams.update({
    'font.family': 'sans-serif',
    'font.sans-serif': ['Microsoft YaHei', 'SimHei', 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans'],
    'axes.unicode_minus': False,
    'font.size': 10,
    'axes.titlesize': 15,
    'axes.labelsize': 11,
    'xtick.labelsize': 9,
    'ytick.labelsize': 9,
    'legend.fontsize': 9,
    'figure.facecolor': 'white',
    'axes.facecolor': 'white',
    'savefig.facecolor': 'white',
    'savefig.dpi': 300,
})

NAVY = '#1F3A93'
ORANGE = '#F39C12'
GREEN = '#27AE60'
TEXT = '#333333'
GRID = '#E0E0E0'

lam = float({{lam}})
sample_size = int({{sample_size}})
random_seed = int({{random_seed}})
if lam <= 0:
    raise RuntimeError('泊松参数 λ 必须大于 0')
if lam > 100000:
    raise RuntimeError('泊松参数 λ 不能超过 100000；更大计数请先缩放单位或使用正态近似')
if sample_size < 10:
    raise RuntimeError('样本量至少为 10')
if sample_size > 100000:
    raise RuntimeError('样本量不能超过 100000；请降低样本量后再绘图')

rng = np.random.default_rng(random_seed)
data = rng.poisson(lam=lam, size=sample_size)

fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(8.5, 5.7))
bins = np.arange(data.min() - 0.5, data.max() + 1.5, 1)
sns.histplot(data, bins=bins, stat='density', color=NAVY, alpha=0.38, edgecolor='white', linewidth=0.8, label='样本频率', ax=ax)
# KDE 只作为样本的平滑描述，不代替离散泊松 PMF。
if np.unique(data).size > 1:
    sns.kdeplot(data, bw_adjust=1.2, cut=0, clip=(0, None), color=ORANGE, linewidth=1.8, label='样本平滑密度（KDE）', ax=ax)

x = np.arange(0, data.max() + 1)
pmf = poisson.pmf(x, mu=lam)
ax.vlines(x, 0, pmf, color=GREEN, alpha=0.72, linewidth=1.3, zorder=3)
ax.scatter(x, pmf, color=GREEN, edgecolor='white', linewidth=0.5, s=34, zorder=4, label='理论泊松 PMF')

ax.set_title('泊松分布：样本与理论概率对比', fontweight='bold', color='#000000', pad=12)
ax.set_xlabel('事件发生次数 k', color=TEXT)
ax.set_ylabel('概率 / 概率密度', color=TEXT)
ax.set_xlim(left=-0.5)
ax.xaxis.set_major_locator(MaxNLocator(integer=True, nbins=12))
ax.spines['top'].set_visible(False)
ax.spines['right'].set_visible(False)
ax.spines['left'].set_color('#999999')
ax.spines['bottom'].set_color('#999999')
ax.spines['left'].set_linewidth(0.8)
ax.spines['bottom'].set_linewidth(0.8)
ax.tick_params(colors=TEXT, direction='out', length=4)
ax.grid(axis='y', linestyle='--', linewidth=0.5, color=GRID, alpha=0.55)
ax.set_axisbelow(True)
ax.legend(frameon=False, loc='best')

_summary = 'λ = {:.4g}    n = {}    样本均值 = {:.4g}    样本方差 = {:.4g}'.format(lam, sample_size, float(np.mean(data)), float(np.var(data, ddof=1)))
ax.text(0.02, 0.97, _summary, transform=ax.transAxes, ha='left', va='top', fontsize=9, color=TEXT, bbox=dict(boxstyle='round,pad=0.35', facecolor='white', edgecolor='#999999', alpha=0.92))
fig.text(0.99, 0.01, '随机种子：{}；KDE 仅作平滑参考，理论分布以 PMF 为准'.format(random_seed), ha='right', fontsize=8, color='#666666', style='italic')
fig.tight_layout(rect=(0, 0.04, 1, 1))

buf = io.BytesIO()
fig.savefig(buf, format='png', bbox_inches='tight', pad_inches=0.18, dpi=300, facecolor='white')
plt.close(fig)
return 'data:image/png;base64,' + base64.b64encode(buf.getvalue()).decode()
